data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 473.6m (2019: GBP 302.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 7.9m (2019: deterioration of GBP 8.4m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability and Accident and Health with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.

prior_year_events.impact_description: The discontinued Contingency class, written on the 2018 and 2019 years of account, was the most severely impacted line as a result of the large number of event cancellations following the restrictions imposed in an effort to contain the virus.

named_events.loss_description: Claims in respect of the Covid-19 pandemic total GBP 128m net of reinsurance recoveries, adding 27% to the net loss ratio. The discontinued Contingency class, written on the 2018 and 2019 years of account, was the most severely impacted line as a result of the large number of event cancellations following the restrictions imposed in an effort to contain the virus.
The Syndicate's biggest exposure to these was through hurricane Laura (net incurred claims of GBP 21.5m).
Additionally, the Syndicate was exposed to Hurricanes Zeta and Sally
as well as to a number of smaller US weather events including the Midwest Derecho storm
and several instances of tornadoes and hail storms.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a GBP 7.9 million strengthening in its prior year reserves for 2020, representing a 1.73% increase relative to its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by unfavourable developments in the Property, Third Party Liability, and Accident & Health lines of business, partially offset by favourable developments in other classes. The year 2020 was significantly impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic, which resulted in GBP 128 million net claims, particularly affecting the discontinued Contingency class from the 2018 and 2019 years of account. Additionally, the Syndicate faced heavy catastrophe experience, including a GBP 21.5 million net loss from Hurricane Laura, along with impacts from Hurricanes Zeta and Sally, the Midwest Derecho storm, and various tornadoes and hail storms.
raw_causal_phrases: unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability and Accident and Health with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes
data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle is distorted by the Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transaction of Syndicates 5820 and 1206 into Syndicate 1861's 2018 year of account, which then impacted the 2017 year of account figures in the table. Therefore, the prior year development was taken from the explicit narrative statement rather than calculated from the triangle. The gross premium mix uses the regulatory segmental analysis, which consolidates "Reinsurance inwards" into a single line item.
